Scientists are using 50-year-old samples to solve the ultimate mystery: How Earth became a blue marble. Today's new video breaks down the revolutionary new analysis of Apollo moon dust that is debunking decades of scientific theory. We dive into the cosmic delivery service that may or may not have brought water to our world.
